label.zh: 允许在己方某个恒星基地建造一个虚境信标。一旦完工，一个虚境隧道会在恒星系中生成，并提供一个通往[shroudwalker_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系的双向隧道。我们只能生成一个虚境隧道；因此请谨慎选择恒星系的位置。
label.en: Permits building a Shroud Beacon on one of our Starbases. Once built, it will spawn a Shroud Tunnel, providing passage to and from the [shroudwalker_enclave_system.GetName] system. Only one Tunnel can be spawned - choose its location carefully.

label.en: Permits building a Shroud Beacon on one of our Starbases. Once built, it will spawn a Shroud Tunnel, providing passage to and from the [shroudwalker_enclave_system.GetName] system. Only one Tunnel can be spawned - choose its location carefully.
